WynnExcavation Site B#000.src: Hello there! We are working very hard here at this excavation site! We have one in {p} as well, I think you should check it out!

WynnExcavation Site B#001.src: Bring the Yellow Crystal Shard to Excavator Lykron at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] The entrance to the cave is at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
WynnExcavation Site B#001.dst: Lleva el fragmento de cristal amarillo al excavador Lykron en [{~}, {~}, -{~}]. La entrada a la cueva está en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

WynnExcavation Site B#002.src: Good day! You're the person that helped us out in the desert aren't you? Excellent! Just the person I need! Can you help me out with a problem I have?
WynnExcavation Site B#002.dst: ¡Buenos días! Tú eres quien nos ayudó en el desierto, ¿verdad? ¡Excelente! ¡Justo a quien necesito! ¿Me ayudas con un problema que tengo?
WynnExcavation Site B#002.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#003.src: Perfect! You see, we are supposed to be searching for some of the... uhhh... long lost ruins of ancient Wynn, just like in the desert!
WynnExcavation Site B#003.dst: ¡Perfecto! Verás, se supone que buscamos unas... eeh... ruinas perdidas hace mucho de la antigua Wynn, ¡igual que en el desierto!
WynnExcavation Site B#003.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#004.src: However, it seems no progress has been made recently; my workers have stopped working!
WynnExcavation Site B#004.dst: Pero parece que últimamente no se avanza nada: ¡mis trabajadores han dejado de trabajar!
WynnExcavation Site B#004.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#005.src: The problem is, there are strange creatures down at the bottom of the cave disturbing them.
WynnExcavation Site B#005.dst: El problema es que en el fondo de la cueva hay criaturas extrañas que los molestan.
WynnExcavation Site B#005.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#006.src: I need you to go and kill them, but first you should go talk to one of my colleagues, he has more information for you.
WynnExcavation Site B#006.dst: Necesito que vayas a matarlas, pero antes habla con uno de mis colegas, él tiene más información para ti.
WynnExcavation Site B#006.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#007.src: He is located directly at the bottom of this cave, go speak to him, go on now! Off you go!
WynnExcavation Site B#007.dst: Está justo en el fondo de esta cueva, ve a hablar con él, ¡venga! ¡En marcha!
WynnExcavation Site B#007.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#008.src: Investigate the depths of the cave
WynnExcavation Site B#008.dst: Investiga las profundidades de la cueva

WynnExcavation Site B#009.src: We know what you stole from us in the desert! Take THIS! You won't be escaping this dead end any time soon!
WynnExcavation Site B#009.dst: ¡Sabemos lo que nos robaste en el desierto! ¡Toma ESTO! ¡No saldrás de este callejón sin salida tan pronto!
WynnExcavation Site B#009.speaker: Flendar

WynnExcavation Site B#013.src: This door is closed; the mine entrance behind it isn't open at this time.
WynnExcavation Site B#013.dst: Esta puerta está cerrada; la entrada a la mina de detrás no está abierta.
WynnExcavation Site B#013.speaker: WynnExcavation Guard

WynnExcavation Site B#014.src: I'm here to make sure no one uses the passage while the archaeologist works.
WynnExcavation Site B#014.dst: Estoy aquí para que nadie use el pasadizo mientras trabaja el arqueólogo.
WynnExcavation Site B#014.speaker: WynnExcavation Guard

WynnExcavation Site B#015.src: You will have to find another exit if you want to get out!
WynnExcavation Site B#015.dst: ¡Si quieres salir, tendrás que buscar otra salida!
WynnExcavation Site B#015.speaker: WynnExcavation Guard

WynnExcavation Site B#016.src: Baffling... What a puzzling situation I am in...
WynnExcavation Site B#016.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#017.src: I cannot open this door for some reason...
WynnExcavation Site B#017.dst: Por algún motivo no puedo abrir esta puerta...
WynnExcavation Site B#017.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#018.src: We suspect the purple crystal is behind this door, but the descriptions in the scriptures don't match this door.
WynnExcavation Site B#018.dst: Sospechamos que el cristal morado está tras esta puerta, pero las descripciones de las escrituras no encajan con ella.
WynnExcavation Site B#018.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#019.src: They seem to describe another door, but all our evidence says otherwise.
WynnExcavation Site B#019.dst: Parecen describir otra puerta, pero todas nuestras pruebas dicen lo contrario.
WynnExcavation Site B#019.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#020.src: The scriptures also say something about hidden within the rocks... But we removed them all!
WynnExcavation Site B#020.dst: Las escrituras también hablan de algo oculto entre las rocas... ¡Pero las quitamos todas!
WynnExcavation Site B#020.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#021.src: Well, the writing isn't actually all that clear. It could mean virtually anything, I think one of these words means hippo! Guess we'll have to find out!
WynnExcavation Site B#021.dst: Bueno, el escrito no está tan claro. Podría significar casi cualquier cosa, ¡creo que una de estas palabras significa hipopótamo! ¡Habrá que averiguarlo!
WynnExcavation Site B#021.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#022.src: Anyway, back to figuring out what needs to be done here... Wait, who are you, you're not an employee of WynnExcavation!
WynnExcavation Site B#022.dst: En fin, volvamos a averiguar qué hay que hacer aquí... Espera, ¿quién eres? ¡No trabajas para WynnExcavation!
WynnExcavation Site B#022.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#024.src: I have to admit, I'm impressed. I genuinely thought our plan would be successful. Who knew that dead end had a secret exit.
WynnExcavation Site B#024.dst: He de admitirlo, estoy impresionado. De verdad creía que nuestro plan funcionaría. Quién iba a saber que ese callejón tenía una salida secreta.
WynnExcavation Site B#024.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#025.src: Not me apparently. We know what you took in the desert, you were just some kid expected to do a delivery job, who knew you'd take a shard of the crystal.
WynnExcavation Site B#025.dst: Yo no, por lo visto. Sabemos lo que te llevaste en el desierto; eras un simple recadero, ¿quién iba a pensar que te quedarías un fragmento del cristal?
WynnExcavation Site B#025.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#026.src: Don't pretend like you don't know what it is, you know as well as I do combining the four crystal shards is told to bring unlimited power!
WynnExcavation Site B#026.dst: No finjas que no sabes qué es; sabes tan bien como yo que, según dicen, unir los cuatro fragmentos de cristal otorga un poder ilimitado.
WynnExcavation Site B#026.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#027.src: You will not interfere any longer. The location of the remaining crystals are known only to us; the fire and leaf crystals are safe.
WynnExcavation Site B#027.dst: No volverás a interferir. Solo nosotros sabemos dónde están los demás cristales; los cristales de fuego y de hoja están a salvo.
WynnExcavation Site B#027.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#028.src: I see that tricking you isn't the way to defeating you. If we ever meet again, we'll be using force and upping our security. Now I never want to see you again. Our socie- I mean company, will not tolerate your interference again.
WynnExcavation Site B#028.dst: Ya veo que engañarte no es la forma de derrotarte. Si volvemos a vernos, usaremos la fuerza y reforzaremos la seguridad. Y ahora no quiero volver a verte. Nuestra socie- digo, empresa, no tolerará otra interferencia tuya.
WynnExcavation Site B#028.speaker: Excavator Lykron
